name: draft and pick/ban
about: Formats that build the deck or your hand before anyone plays.

formats.name: draft
formats.about: Point cards are in. Everything else gets drafted into the deck, then everyone drafts their starting hand from packs passed around the table.

formats.name: hand draft
formats.about: Everyone gets a pack, takes a card and passes the rest on until your starting hands are full.

formats.name: pick and ban
formats.about: 12 random cards go on the table. Everyone bans two (every copy leaves the deck), then picks one to start with.

formats.name: 1v1 draft
formats.about: Competitive 1v1: ban two from the whole deck, pick one into your hand, then draft the rest of your hand.
